messages.subject: Executive application | Sustainable development, ESG and stakeholder leadership
messages.body:
Dear Pruksa Recruitment Team,

I am submitting my executive profile through Pruksa’s published recruitment address after my earlier note to Investor Relations was rejected by my email provider before delivery.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination, strategic partnerships and executive stakeholder strategy across a major international investment and operating environment.

Pruksa’s property, health and sustainability platform aligns with my experience working where investment, public institutions, communities and operating teams meet. I bring structured government engagement, stakeholder governance, ESG execution and cross-functional follow-through. My recent work also includes energy-transition and carbon-governance initiatives.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional mandates across Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, ESG, Strategic Partnerships, Country Leadership or related executive roles. I am internationally mobile and available following a 30-day notice period.

My attached CV is tailored to Pruksa. I would value a confidential discussion with the relevant senior HR or business leader.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
